name: type-mask-up
about: Editorial headline that rises out of a mask line by line, flush left.

name: type-slam
about: One word slams in from 3x with blur, for beat cuts.

name: type-crop
about: One word set far larger than the frame, cropped by the edges, drifting slowly: type as image, not label.

name: line-draw
about: A hand-drawn stroke that draws itself on (underline, route, chart line).

name: grid-field
about: A field of 40 dots in a row, each rising with its own delay ($i).

name: push-in
about: Slow camera push-in for calm shots.

name: snap-zoom
about: Snap zoom with an impact shake on the cut (fast pace).

name: whip-pan
about: Whip pan in from the side (pair with scene motionBlur).

name: music-orchestral
about: Orchestral score with a hit on bar 5.

name: grade-film
about: Gentle cinematic grade with restrained bloom.
